def evolved_fsdp_prefetch(shards, M, N_LAYERS, rank, world_size,
                          num_devices, cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Batch all-gathers maximally: group tensors of identical shape, one AG per group.

    Each outputs[m][L] is the full all-gathered weight (dim=-1) of shards[m][L].
    Stacking along a new leading dim keeps per-item dim=-1 gather correct while
    collapsing M*N_LAYERS collective calls into one AG per distinct shape. Data
    volume is fixed (weights differ per microbatch), so this hits the data-bound
    floor with minimal op/collective overhead.
    """
    outs = [[None] * N_LAYERS for _ in range(M)]
    groups = {}
    for m in range(M):
        for L in range(N_LAYERS):
            t = shards[m][L]
            groups.setdefault(tuple(t.shape), []).append((m, L))
    for shp, items in groups.items():
        stacked = torch.stack([shards[m][L] for (m, L) in items], dim=0)
        gathered = xm.all_gather(stacked, dim=-1)
        for i, (m, L) in enumerate(items):
            outs[m][L] = gathered[i]
    return outs
